{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
df_dedup = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Correct batch-B values: divide by 10 to convert from µg/L to ng/mL
corrected_final = df_dedup['biomarker_final'].copy()
corrected_final[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B'] /= 10

# Compute the mean
mean_biomarker_final = corrected_final.mean()

# Print all required numbers explicitly
print(f"Number of unique patients after deduplication: {df_dedup.shape[0]}")
print(f"Number of patients with assay_batch == 'B': {df_dedup['assay_batch'].eq('B').sum()}")
print(f"Original mean biomarker_final (before correction): {df_dedup['biomarker_final'].mean():.2f}")
print(f"Corrected mean biomarker_final: {mean_biomarker_final:.2f} ng/mL")

# Confirm no -999 in biomarker_final
print(f"Number of biomarker_final == -999: {corrected_final.eq(-999).sum()}")"}
